preparation_parameters.name: photon_energy
preparation_parameters.role: physical optical input, conditional on absorption
preparation_parameters.uncertainty: No laser spectral uncertainty supplied; these are nominal conversions.

preparation_parameters.name: retained_energy
preparation_parameters.unit: J or eV with explicit conversion
preparation_parameters.role: effective total excess energy handed to resolved sectors
preparation_parameters.bounds: 0 <= E_in <= E_gamma, conditional on no other impulsive source
constraints: Post-handoff phonon escape is not included again in prior loss.
No additional simultaneous electronic photon-energy jump when all excess is assigned to B.39 phonons.

preparation_parameters.name: retention_fraction
preparation_parameters.role: effective preparation closure, not absorption efficiency
preparation_parameters.common_between_colors: recommended controlled hypothesis, not a measurement

published_scenarios.status: fit in historical 1D model; not adopted for D.30
thermal 2D preparation fit, printed 103; not adopted
phonon-bubble 2D preparation fit, printed 103; not adopted

preparation_parameters.not_a_range: These different fits do not define an admissible interval or confidence interval.
preparation_parameters.proposal_reason: Matches selected K20 device/model reference; baseline for a controlled new-model scenario, not a universal conversion efficiency.
preparation_parameters.unverified_value_0_49: Not confirmed in consulted A19v2, V19v1, K20 or inspected A20 passages; do not attribute to the inaccessible published A19 revision.
convention_notes: A19 Eq.5 defines deposited E as electronic plus phononic excess.
K20 methods define chi after down-conversion; simplified electronic illustrations are not instructions to duplicate deposition.
D.30 would assign proposed retained total once to its phonon preparation; validity of that changed partition is not calibrated by a historical fit.

preparation_parameters.name: spatial_width
preparation_parameters.definition: Untruncated Gaussian standard deviation per coordinate; normalization is over deposition domain.
constraints: Hotbelt length is not a 2D Gaussian width.
A radial energy-containment radius is not a Gaussian standard deviation.
No 5–20 nm physical interval is established here.
Boundary normalization conserves prescribed energy but does not model previous escape.
preparation_parameters.gaussian_shape: User modeling choice, not claimed as a measured spatial distribution.

preparation_parameters.name: handoff_time
preparation_parameters.time_origin: Simulation may set t0=0 without setting the physical optical delay to zero.
preparation_parameters.relative_latency_identity: Delta t_registered = Delta(t0-t_abs) + Delta tau_resolved + Delta t_readout_or_path; Delta means 1550 minus 775 nm.
limits: A common offset cancels conditionally; color-dependent offsets do not.
Modes of distributions are not generally additive.
tau_DC in A20 is not a measured handoff delay.
A19 separates initial equilibration from detector response; it does not identify the D.30 handoff instant.
V19 begins with an already heated electron-plus-phonon state; t=0 there is not a computed optical cascade duration.

preparation_parameters.name: initial_phonon_excess
preparation_parameters.role: adopted effective spectral closure in model 0.4
constraints: Omega is energy, not angular frequency without hbar conversion.
Common nonnegative support and finite positive M1 required.
Use same support/quadrature for normalization and ledger.
Unchanged condensate and circuit states; initial electrons at bath Fermi-Dirac.

preparation_parameters.name: deposition_position
preparation_parameters.role: event location versus ensemble optical weighting
preparation_parameters.recommendation: Interior deterministic event for controlled mechanism study; do not call it the experimental ensemble average.

preparation_parameters.name: Fano_extension
preparation_parameters.symbol: F_N or F_eff with specified convention
constraints: Quasiparticle-number variance does not automatically equal retained-total-energy variance.
Specify sectors, energy scale and loss mechanism before assigning variance.
Require physical energy support and correlations.
A deterministic latency does not predict jitter FWHM.

decisions_and_open_items.question_es: ¿Se quiere comprobar la formación del hotbelt desde un depósito localizado, o imponerlo para estudiar la respuesta posterior?
decisions_and_open_items.recommendation: Localized 2D preparation if formation is the target.
decisions_and_open_items.consequence: A prescribed belt cannot validate its own formation or transverse homogenization.
decisions_and_open_items.answer: Sí: primero latencia relativa y formación del hotbelt
